title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Paint and Grille Replacement
summary: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE received a front grille replacement and a complete hood refinish at Carcis Autobody Repair.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to the shop for front-end repair work involving hood repainting and grille replacement. Front-end components like the hood and grille often sustain damage from road debris or minor collisions, requiring careful refinishing and panel alignment.

The technician removed the original damaged grille and installed a new replacement grille assembly. To prepare the hood for refinishing, the surface was thoroughly cleaned, sanded, and primed to eliminate surface imperfections and ensure full paint adhesion.
A color-matched black base coat was sprayed onto the hood, followed by a durable clear coat layer. Once cured, the finish was polished to match the vehicle's glossy black appearance.
